headings.style_instructions: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for H1. Apply a framer-motion masked line-by-line reveal on initial page load.

body.style_instructions: Clean, highly readable, tracking-normal. Minimalist approach with generous line heights.

accent.style_instructions: Used for numbered manifesto chapters, overlines, and technical metadata.

colors.instructions: Keep the existing brand essence (blue structure) but modernize it. Transition between stark white minimalist sections and immersive dark navy sections. Strictly follow the 'Tinted Grey' rule.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating elements, especially on Reference cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark sections to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes with low opacity (border-black/10 or border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header. backdrop-blur-xl with border-white/20.

layouts.hero: Large kinetic typography. Subtle parallax or TSParticles abstract air/flow background element. Masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 on load.
layouts.grid: Bento-box style for service cards. Asymmetry in text blocks.
layouts.sections: Numbered manifesto chapters. Slow editorial marquee separating sections. Clipped frames for photography.

motion.reveal: Framer Motion scroll-reveals (fade up, subtle scale, and clipped image reveals).
motion.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons, slow hover image scaling inside clipped frames.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Ensure overlays on hero are bg-black/50 or bg-white/40 max.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Use framer-motion for the masked line-by-line text reveal on H1.
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
Implement the 'Tjänster' section as an elegant grid or accordion.
Create a slow editorial marquee separating key sections.
Maintain a strict professional tone but with highly dynamic awwwards-level interactions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add subtle grain textures and custom selection states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
